title: Wooden stool
brief: A round wooden stool with three splayed legs and a flat seat.

title: Mushroom cluster
brief: Three red mushrooms with white spots, one tall and two small, growing from a patch of grass.

title: Street lamp
brief: A black iron street lamp with a curved arm and a glass lantern that glows warm yellow.

title: Mailbox with flag
brief: A blue mailbox on a wooden post whose red flag swings up and down in a loop.

title: Ice cream cone
brief: An ice cream cone with a waffle cone and two scoops, pink and chocolate, with a cherry on top.

title: Sailboat
brief: A small sailboat with a white hull, a mast and one triangular red sail.

title: Cottage garden set
brief: A garden set side by side: a wooden bench, a round bird bath and a small picket fence section.

title: Robot dog
brief: A boxy robot dog with four legs, a tail antenna and glowing blue eyes.

title: Spinning fan
brief: A desk fan with a round base, a neck and a three-blade rotor that spins.

title: Stone tower
brief: A round stone watchtower with a crenellated top, a wooden door and two narrow windows.

title: Potion bottles
brief: Three glass potion bottles of different shapes and colours: red round, green tall, purple square, each with a cork.

title: Hot air balloon
brief: A hot air balloon with a striped envelope, a wicker basket and ropes that gently bobs up and down.
